blocks.text: Is theory ke mutabiq har particle ko ek field se dikhaya jata hai jisay quantum field kehte hain; yahi field ek mediator ke zariye ek particle se doosre tak force pohanchati hai. Maslan ek positive charged particle apne gird space mein electric field banata hai, aur isi field ke zariye qareeb ke negative charged particle ko kheenchta hai. Field ek particle se doosre tak energy aur momentum bhi le ja sakti hai. Tamam fields ki energy aur momentum quantized hai, yani chhote chhote packets mein. Jo quanta (packets) field mein ek particle se doosre tak energy aur momentum pohanchate hain, unhein field particles kehte hain. Is tarah particles ke interactions field particles (quanta) ke exchange (len-den) se samjhaye jate hain, aur yeh sab bosons hain. Electromagnetic force photons se (electromagnetic field ke quanta), strong nuclear force gluons se, weak force W aur Z bosons se, aur gravity gravitons se pohanchti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer ke saath hum matter ke andar ek level neeche jate hain: molecule atoms se, atom nucleus aur electrons se, nucleus neutrons aur protons se, aur neutron ya proton quarks se bana hai. Size dekhein: 10⁻¹⁰ m ka atom 10⁻¹⁵ m ke proton se taqreeban ek lakh (10⁵) guna bara hai. Quark ka size 10⁻¹⁸ m se bhi kam hai.
